_comment: Body app, Recover tab. Mat routines (stretch, yoga, roll) with durations in seconds so the app can run them as timers, the breathing exercise with its timer spec, sleep basics, and a comparison of sleep trackers. Tracker prices were read on each maker's own US store on 2026-10-29. Places to sauna, plunge and get a massage are in recover-spots.json. Research behind the numbers, kept off the screen: cyclic sighing, Balban et al., Cell Reports Medicine 2023, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36630953; adult sleep, CDC, cdc.gov/sleep/about. General wellness information, not medical advice.
why: Muscles grow on the days off.

routines.name: Ten-minute stretch
routines.when: After a workout, or at night.
routines.cue: Ease in. Back off if anything pinches.

moves.name: Calf stretch
moves.how: Hands on a wall. One foot back, heel down.

moves.name: Quad stretch
moves.how: Hold a wall. Pull one heel to your butt.

moves.name: Hamstring stretch
moves.how: On your back, towel around one foot. Lift the leg.

moves.name: Hip flexor stretch
moves.how: One knee down. Squeeze that glute, hips forward.

moves.name: Figure four
moves.how: On your back, ankle over knee. Pull the bottom leg in.

moves.name: Child's pose
moves.how: Knees wide, hips to heels, arms long.

moves.name: Chest stretch
moves.how: Forearm on a door frame. Step through.

moves.name: Shoulder stretch
moves.how: Pull one arm across your chest.

moves.name: Seated twist
moves.how: Sit tall, foot over the other knee. Turn toward it.

moves.name: Neck stretch
moves.how: Ear toward shoulder. Other hand reaches down.

routines.name: Twenty-minute yoga
routines.when: Rest days, mornings, or when you're stiff.
routines.cue: Move with your breath. Rest in child's pose anytime.

moves.name: Easy seat
moves.how: Sit cross-legged. Slow breaths through your nose.

moves.name: Cat and cow
moves.how: Hands and knees. Round on the exhale, arch on the inhale.

moves.name: Thread the needle
moves.how: Slide one arm under you. Rest that shoulder down.

moves.name: Downward dog
moves.how: Hips up and back, knees soft. Pedal your heels.

moves.name: Low lunge
moves.how: Foot between your hands, back knee down. Chest up.

moves.name: Half split
moves.how: From the lunge, hips back. Straighten the front leg.

moves.name: Lizard
moves.how: Foot outside your hand, back knee down. Sink your hips.

moves.name: Pigeon or figure four
moves.how: Front shin across the mat, fold forward. Knee hurts? Do figure four.

moves.name: Bridge
moves.how: On your back, feet flat. Lift your hips, hold, lower. Repeat.

moves.name: Supine twist
moves.how: On your back, drop both knees to one side.

moves.name: Happy baby
moves.how: On your back, hold your feet. Rock side to side.

moves.name: Lying still
moves.how: Flat on your back. Let your breath slow.

routines.name: Ten-minute foam roll
routines.when: Before or after a workout, or on rest days.
routines.cue: Roll slowly. Pause on tender spots. Skip your lower back and bones.

moves.name: Calves
moves.how: Roller under one calf, other leg on top.

moves.name: Hamstrings
moves.how: Roller under your thighs, hands behind you.

moves.name: Quads
moves.how: Face down on your forearms, roller under your thighs.

moves.name: Outer hip
moves.how: On your side, top foot on the floor.

moves.name: Glutes
moves.how: Sit on the roller, ankle over knee. Lean that way.

moves.name: Upper back
moves.how: Roller across your shoulder blades, hands behind your head.

moves.name: Lats
moves.how: On your side, arm overhead, roller under your armpit.

breathe.name: The double inhale
breathe.aka: Cyclic sighing, also called the physiological sigh.
breathe.what: Two breaths in through your nose. One long breath out.

presets.label: Five minutes
presets.use: Once a day. This is the studied dose.

timer.rule: Breathe out longer than you breathe in. Light-headed? Stop.

meditation.name: One-minute reset
meditation.how: Eyes closed. Count ten slow breaths. Lose count? Start over.

meditation.name: Three-minute body scan
meditation.how: Feet, legs, belly, chest, shoulders, jaw, face. Soften each one.

meditation.name: Five-minute walk
meditation.how: Outside, phone away. Notice what you see and hear.

sleep.why: Adults need seven hours or more.
basics: Wake at the same time every day.
Get outside light within an hour of waking.
No caffeine within eight hours of bed.
Keep the bedroom cool, dark and quiet.
Phone across the room. Thirty screen-free minutes before bed.
No big meals or alcohol close to bed.
Awake after twenty minutes? Get up until you're sleepy.

trackers.name: Apple Watch
trackers.measures: Sleep stages, heart rate, breathing, wrist temperature.
trackers.cost: SE 3 from $249, Series 12 from $399. No subscription.
trackers.best_for: iPhone users who want one device.

trackers.name: Google Fitbit and Pixel Watch
trackers.measures: Sleep stages and score, heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen.
trackers.cost: Fitbit Air from $99.99, Pixel Watch from $399.99. Premium from $9.99 a month.
trackers.best_for: Android users who want a cheap band.

trackers.name: Oura Ring
trackers.measures: Sleep score and stages, resting heart rate, HRV, body temperature.
trackers.cost: Ring 4 from $349, Ring 5 from $399, plus $5.99 a month.
trackers.best_for: People who hate sleeping in a watch.

trackers.name: WHOOP
trackers.measures: Sleep, strain and recovery scores, HRV, skin temperature.
trackers.cost: Membership from $199 a year, band included.
trackers.best_for: Heavy trainers who want a daily recovery score.
trackers.tradeoff: No screen. You pay every year.

trackers.name: Phone apps
trackers.measures: Time in bed and estimated sleep.
trackers.cost: Free to start. Built into iPhone and Android.

sleep.tracker_tip: Start with one number: hours slept.
